_doc: Mutation-kill ratchet for claim-critical modules — the falsification loop's K operator as ENFORCED infrastructure, not a one-off measurement. floor = the logic (compare/boolop) mutation kill-rate the module's tests currently achieve. scripts/ci/check_mutation_kill_ratchet.py RE-PROBES a module (tools/mutation_probe.py --only-logic) whenever its source or its tests change, and FAILS if the kill-rate drops below floor — so a PR that weakens the tests for these modules cannot merge. floors may only RISE (monotone-up): closing a survivor and raising the floor is the only sanctioned direction. See docs/meta/FALSIFICATION_LOOP.md. RECURSION (K applied to K): the ratchet's own verifier scripts/ci/check_mutation_kill_ratchet.py is enrolled here too, so changing it re-probes it with its own test suite — the output of the gate is fed back as the gate's input. Its lone surviving mutant (the cosmetic 'ok'/'REGRESSED' status label, printed but never asserted) is a proven-equivalent mutant; floor 0.88 = 8/9 non-equivalent sites killed.
